card.name: Just before a number or drug-name start
card.fires_on: The space or first character just before a number (like 5%, 15%, 0.5 mg, 5.1) or a brand-name start such as XADAGO or AUSTEDO. It fires at the point where the next piece is a digit or the rest of a name.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space or digit-start right before a dose figure, percentage or section reference.
modes.example: the daily dose should be increased slowly by<< >>5% to 15% only

modes.label: Start of a brand name
modes.description: The first letter or two of a capitalized brand name split into pieces.
modes.example: consider discontinuing treatment with<< A>>USTEDO XR or AUSTED

modes.label: Stray linking word
modes.description: A short word like of or in before a following noun in running text.
modes.example: One to 2 mg<< of>> benztropine mesylate tablets

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly suppresses the word control and variants.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number or the rest of a brand name is about to appear.
